title: Comparative Dataset of Cultural Impact Assessment Frameworks
descriptions: This dataset provides a comparative analysis of selected cultural impact assessment frameworks developed by international and institutional actors. It maps their scope, key themes, indicators, and methodological approaches, and serves as an empirical basis for the development of the Cultural Impact Assessment framework in the HL-EXURB project.
